 import dataclasses

@@ -21,6 +22,7 @@ from typing import (

     PYDANTIC_V2,

 def get_typed_signature(call: Callable[..., Any]) -> inspect.Signature:
     signature = inspect.signature(call)
-    unwrapped = inspect.unwrap(call)

@@ -218,13 +219,12 @@ def get_typed_annotation(annotation: Any, globalns: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
 
 def get_typed_return_annotation(call: Callable[..., Any]) -> Any:

     annotation = signature.return_annotation
 
     if annotation is inspect.Signature.empty:

diff --git a/fastapi/utils.py b/fastapi/utils.py
index b3b89ed2..60b97f0e 100644
--- a/fastapi/utils.py
+++ b/fastapi/utils.py
@@ -1,3 +1,5 @@
+import functools
+import inspect
 import re
 import warnings
 from dataclasses import is_dataclass
@@ -258,3 +260,13 @@ def get_value_or_default(
         if not isinstance(item, DefaultPlaceholder):
             return item
     return first_item
+
+def get_callable_globals(call: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    unwrapped = inspect.unwrap(call)
+    while isinstance(unwrapped, functools.partial):
+        unwrapped = unwrapped.func
+    if hasattr(unwrapped, "__globals__"):
+        return unwrapped.__globals__
+    if hasattr(unwrapped, "__call__"):
+        return getattr(unwrapped.__call__, "__globals__", {})
+    return {}
